title: Voxel-style castle tower (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Build a cylindrical tower approximated from stacked cube 'voxel' blocks arranged in a ring per level, topped with alternating raised/lowered crenellation blocks around the rim. Tower height (levels), ring radius (in voxel units), and crenellation pattern must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
